scientific_interpretation: NO NATIVE_ENTITY_BINDING OR CAUSAL_TRANSFER ACCEPTANCE. Input remains four fixed sensory coordinates, original stream operator hidden; new contexts generated deterministically.
methodological_limits: The precode implementation's world resets model state across independently seeded worlds; there is no cumulative cross-world learned knowledge.

Training seed cohort was evaluated with fixed update hyperparameters but no separately trained persistent weights carried to the other cohorts; therefore this is an online-adaptation feasibility screen, not learned source-to-new-source parameter transfer.
Observational next-state prediction does not identify causal interventions; interpreting the hidden matrix as a causal model is not justified by observations alone.
Memory erasure is performed at the start of returning A and not independently strong evidence of learned identity retention.
Resource fairness of all comparators includes declared but unmatched resident state sizes, arithmetic and learning-cost accounting; no superiority claim.
